title: joserfc: Unbounded JWE General JSON `recipients` Array Leads to CPU Exhaustion (DoS) via Repeated RSA Private-Key…
description: The joserfc library's decrypt_json() function for JWE General JSON Serialization does not limit the number of recipients in the 'recipients' array. An attacker can supply a JWE with an unbounded number of recipients, causing the library to perform a costly RSA private-key decryption operation for each recipient. This leads to a CPU exhaustion denial-of-service (DoS) condition. The library's documented mitigation option verify_all_recipients=False does not reduce CPU usage, as all recipients are decrypted unconditionally before this flag is checked. A fix is available in version 2.15.0_3.
